items.title: PaperPilot – Zero-Cloud, Pure-Rust PDF Engine with WASM and MCP
items.summary_zh: PaperPilot 是一个基于纯 Rust 开发的 PDF 引擎，支持 WASM 和 MCP 协议，旨在提供高性能、零云端的文档处理能力。
items.why_zh: 属于高性能计算与 Agent 工具集成领域，可学习如何通过 WASM 实现跨平台轻量级工具部署，以及如何将本地引擎封装为 MCP Server。

items.title: Syenzzz/mcd-coupon-strategist
items.summary: 麦麦省钱助手 —— 基于麦当劳 MCP 的点餐成本优化 Skill。算出当前门店最省钱的点餐方案，并主动提示凑单陷阱。
items.summary_zh: mcd-coupon-strategist 是一个基于麦当劳 MCP 的点餐优化工具，通过算法计算门店最优凑单组合并识别消费陷阱。
items.why_zh: 属于 MCP 应用开发领域，可学习如何利用 MCP 协议构建特定领域（Domain-specific）的决策辅助 Agent，实现外部 API 的逻辑封装。

items.title: Don't Forget What You Just Learned: Self-Directed Repair Turns Agent Mistakes Into Lasting Lessons
items.summary: arXiv:2610.31846v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Intelligent agents should learn from their mistakes so that experience leads to continuous improvement. Yet today's agents recover from a mistake only temporarily: in-context reflections are easily forgotten across sessions and compete for limited context, while full-parameter fine-tuning is expensive and can interfere with existing capabilities. We introduce Self-Direction, a mechanism for agents to learn from mistakes that combines the benefits o
items.summary_zh: 提出 Self-Directed Repair 方法，通过自主纠错机制将 Agent 错误转化为持久化知识，避免了上下文遗忘和昂贵的参数微调。
items.why_zh: 属于 Agent 持续学习与记忆管理领域，可学习如何设计轻量级的错误修正反馈回路，提升 Agent 在多轮交互中的长期稳定性。

items.title: Tradeoff-Aware Territory Design: A Multi-Objective Decision System for Enterprise Customer-to-Seller Allocation
items.summary: arXiv:2610.31701v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Enterprise customer journeys are shaped not only by product experiences and marketing, but also by recurring resource-allocation decisions. In B2B go-to-market (GTM) organizations, territory carving determines which accounts receive seller coverage, which seller-account relationships are preserved, and how limited field capacity is distributed. Yet the process often remains manual, making it difficult to compare opportunities, value continuity, and
items.summary_zh: 提出一种多目标决策系统，用于企业 B2B 场景下的客户与销售人员分配，平衡资源覆盖与销售关系稳定性。
items.why_zh: 属于复杂决策系统与运筹优化领域，可学习如何将业务约束转化为多目标优化问题，并利用 AI 辅助企业级资源调度决策。

items.title: Patronizing and Condescending Language Detection in English and Mandarin
items.summary: arXiv:2610.31808v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Patronizing and condescending language (PCL) is a form of harmful language that belittles and assumes pity for vulnerable groups, reinforcing negative societal stereotypes. However, unlike overt hate speech, it is often difficult to detect, even for human judges. This paper proposes a system for the automated detection of PCL. Our first approach uses static word embeddings and a convolutional neural network for classification, while our second appr
items.summary_zh: 构建了针对英语和中文的“居高临下语言”（PCL）检测系统，旨在识别隐蔽的社会偏见与负面刻板印象。
items.why_zh: 属于 NLP 伦理与内容安全领域，可学习如何构建细粒度情感分析模型，以及如何处理跨语言语境下的隐性语义识别任务。

items.title: Tsinghua AI Open-Sources AKV, a Cache Engineering Server for LLM Agents on SGLang
items.summary: Tsinghua researchers released AKV, an SGLang-based serving system for cache engineering. LLM agents drop and reposition KV cache instead of summarizing history, cutting average cost 27.7% across 4 agent benchmarks. The post Tsinghua AI Open-Sources AKV, a Cache Engineering Server for LLM Agents on SGLang appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: 清华大学开源 AKV，这是一个基于 SGLang 的 KV Cache 工程化服务系统，通过直接操作缓存提升 LLM Agent 效率。
items.why_zh: 属于 LLM 推理优化领域，可学习如何通过 KV Cache 缓存管理替代传统的历史摘要，从而降低 Agent 推理成本并提升响应速度。

items.title: Yzmblog/DMAD

items.summary_zh: DMAD 提出一种将分布匹配作为对抗性蒸馏的方法，旨在加速视觉生成模型的推理速度。
items.why_zh: 属于模型压缩与加速领域，可学习如何通过对抗性训练实现高效的知识蒸馏，优化生成式模型的推理延迟。

Using LangChain's internal GTM agent as the example, he shows how an agent is scaffolded into one project structure with the mda CLI, run locally in LangSmith Studio, and deployed on LangSmith Deployment, then cov…
items.summary_zh: LangChain 推出 Managed Deep Agents，通过集成 LangSmith 基础设施，支持将深度智能体从本地原型迁移至生产环境。
items.why_zh: 属于 Agent 工程化领域，可学习如何构建生产级 Agent 架构，利用基础设施实现业务逻辑与智能体编排的解耦。

items.why_zh: 属于 Agent 应用开发领域，可学习如何设计多工具调用的 Agent 工作流，实现从内容生产到反馈闭环的自动化。

items.title: Seam Cutter

Effectively it lets you crop out a section in the middle of an image. I wanted this because I often use Tailor on my iPhone to stitch several screenshots together into lot long image, but sometimes I find myself wanting to crop out a section in the middle - to redact an irrelevant prompt from a transcript, for exa…
items.summary_zh: Seam Cutter 是一个图像裁剪工具，允许用户在图像中进行水平或垂直切割，并平移两侧以去除中间部分。
items.why_zh: 属于图像处理算法应用领域，可学习如何通过简单的几何变换逻辑解决特定场景下的图像编辑需求，提升工具开发的实用性。

items.title: Researchers from Stanford and UC Berkeley Introduce TokenGate: Token-Gated Attention Makes Long-Context Prefill Up to 11.3x Faster
items.summary: Stanford and UC Berkeley researchers released TokenGate, a drop-in learned token pruning module for LLMs. It cuts long-context prefill time-to-first-token by 1.4x to 11.3x and peak memory by 1.5x to 3.4x without accuracy loss. The post Researchers from Stanford and UC Berkeley Introduce TokenGate: Token-Gated Attention Makes Long-Context Prefill Up to 11.3x Faster appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Stanford 和 UC Berkeley 提出 TokenGate 模块，通过学习型 Token 剪枝技术，在不损失精度的情况下，将长上下文 Prefill 阶段的 TTFT 速度提升 1.4 至 11.3 倍，并显著降低峰值内存占用。
items.why_zh: 属于 LLM 推理优化领域。可学习如何通过动态剪枝策略减少 Attention 计算冗余，复用该方法优化长文本处理的推理延迟与显存瓶颈。

However, agent effectiveness depends heavily on the surrounding harness, which typically relies on manually written skills and curated memory. This limits autonomous learning, forcing agents to repeatedly rediscover solutions rather than retain and reuse knowledge from prior executi
